name: NOAA West Coast VDatum NAVD88 GEOID09 to MLLW lead for SCC and Big Sur South

spatial.horizontal_crs: Source CSUMB raster EPSG:26910; exact NAD83 realization and epoch unresolved
spatial.vertical_datum: Source NAVD88 Geoid09; target MLLW only for queried points

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly service-availability and source-frame review; service model may change

evidence.supports: Official API supports explicit source GEOID09, NAVD88, MLLW and returned uncertainty; West Coast tidal target frame is IGS14.
West Coast tidal transformation follows a distinct IGS14/xGEOID20B path; source frame and uncertainty require explicit review.
The original CSUMB SCC block is a separately archived historic survey; its native inspected raster is EPSG:26910 and NAVD88 Geoid09.

limitations: Seven South Central Coast and Big Sur South raster-envelope midpoint requests returned offsets and conversion uncertainty, but those points are not verified native measured cells and do not define a full grid transformation.

The original CSUMB grid identifies NAD83 / UTM zone 10 but not its horizontal realization or coordinate epoch. The API rejected NAD83_1986 and accepted NAD83_2011; treating those frames as equivalent would be an unsupported source transformation.
VDatum conversion uncertainty is separate from original grid vertical error; this source lacks a per-cell product uncertainty band.
Original substrate, current MPAs and other closures, hazards, route, species/date/method rules and fish evidence remain independent promotion gates. No fishing target or export is supported.

provenance.access_service: Official NOAA VDatum West Coast JSON API
transformations: Queried GEOID09 NAVD88 zero-height points at seven inspected SCC/BSS raster-envelope midpoints; recorded exact request URL and response SHA-256 for each.
Probed NAD83_1986 source frame separately; official API returned error 412 requiring NAD83_2011.
Preserved source-frame and missing raster-product uncertainty holds; produced no converted raster, spot or export.
